name: kTAF liquidation seize rounding
summary: Repeated tiny liquidations rounded the seized kTAF collateral up, allowing more collateral to be redeemed than the DAI repaid was worth.
notes: The direct kTAF runtime was created by this transaction and its code hash remained unchanged through the exploit.
The exploit receipt records an exact 8,187.514103413431539366 DAI transfer from the attack contract to the attacker after the 4,000 DAI Balancer flash loan was repaid.
